text: Top of the seventh, one out, runner on first. Stepping in for the visitors is the left fielder, Marcus Bell. He's oh for two tonight with a walk. On the mound, Danny Cruz has been working quick all night. Mostly fastballs, sitting around ninety three, and he hasn't let anybody square one up since the second inning.
Bell digs in. Cruz looks in for the sign. Checks the runner at first. Comes set.

The pitch! Swung on, and a line drive into the right center field gap! Sanchez is running hard from center, he dives, can't get there! It rolls to the wall! The runner rounds second, he's being waved home! Here comes the throw to the cutoff man Ortiz, he turns and fires! The slide! And he is safe! Safe at the plate! Bell pulls into second with a double, and this is a one run ball game!

Well, Cruz had been cruising, but that one caught too much of the plate, and Bell did not miss it. Sanchez laid out for it in the gap, and it was just past his glove. The pitching coach is making his way out to the mound, so we'll take a breath here.
